text:
sandra_cs: Quick sync — StratusHealth onboarding call just wrapped. They reported three clustered asks affecting go-live: (1) embedding freshness (results >12h stale), (2) per-route cost visibility in the console for billing owners, (3) ability to set role-based access to generation templates.
sandra_cs: Noted that renewal conversation is in 10 weeks; CSM flagged medium risk if embedding issue persists.
julie_cs: Copied verbatim from customer: "we reindex nightly but users see old answers for same query, breaking trust" — they gave example query + doc id, I pasted into the ticket.
noah_pm: Thanks. Can we triage impact and effort? Suggest we do a quick technical spike on embedding staleness first (highest trust/regression risk).
arjun_eng: Re: embeddings — current infra TTL = 24h (cache.ttl=86400). We do full reindex job nightly; incremental invalidation is possible but requires index change and a small streaming consumer. Rough effort: spike 3d, feature 2w.
maria_data: I'll pull metrics for affected customers (query variance, requery rates) — need at least 5 similar incidents to justify full feature.
sandra_cs: +1 on metrics. Customer says 4 different teams hit it in first week, so sample likely exists.
opsbot: New ticket created: CS-4822 — "StratusHealth embedding staleness + per-route billing ask" (assigned to product).
noah_pm: Proposal: spike (P0) for embed staleness to surface repro and telemetry; per-route billing and RBAC templating as P1/P2 workstreams. If spike shows trivial infra change we can fast-follow.
arjun_eng: I'll own the spike — plan: reproduce with their sample, simulate reindex cadence, and draft two approaches: TTL shrink vs event-driven invalidation. Will post findings in 3 days and open an infra RFC if needed.
julie_cs: I'll gather 5 support threads + example prompts and share the direct links here. Also will ask Stratus for permission to run a synthetic requery test against their staging.
maria_data: Once I have metrics, I'll compute a quick severity score (incidents/week, affected users, renewal exposure) and add to the ticket.
sandra_cs: Great. For roadmap/comms: can we get a short blurb to tell Stratus what's coming? even a one-liner helps with renewal.
noah_pm: I'll draft a one-paragraph turnaround note after arjun posts spike results. Tagging @product-leads for visibility :eyes:.
sandra_cs: Thanks team — let's reconvene when ticket has spike notes. :thumbsup:
